sources.title: sprited-ai/birefnet: The complete BiRefNet on Replicate - GitHub
sources.snippet: The complete BiRefNet on Replicate. Replicate's existing BiRefNet endpoint serves only the legacy general weights with a single resolution knob — this brings the full model zoo, real output controls, and the ToonOut anime fine-tune behind one endpoint.

sources.title: Physical artificial intelligence - Wikipedia
sources.snippet: Physical artificial intelligence or physical AI refers to artificial intelligence (AI) systems that perceive, reason about and act within the physical world, specially at the human scale.
